unknown_usage: charge 60000 reservation and halt new physical calls across batch

scoring: post-inference only, current labels; historical uncertain is not wrong-root correction
limitations: two known incidents; not independent population evidence
adaptive foreground bound five calls, not exact three-call DAG
exploratory SLOs; no course or production SLA
no external publication or operational writes
